21.name: Whitfield approves corrected sequence
21.description: Whitfield finally stamps the corrected sequence and says he will personally carry it into the one o'clock meeting.
evidence: Whitfield's finger came down on the four-eighteen stamp at last, and he said only that he would carry the corrected sequence into the one o'clock himself

21.name: Whitfield excludes Asha from Devin's conversation
21.description: Whitfield tells Asha not to be in the room when Devin speaks.
evidence: that she was not to be in the room when Devin spoke

21.name: Whitfield sends Asha home
21.description: Whitfield dismisses Asha and tells her to go home for the remaining four hours of her shift.
evidence: that she should go home for the four hours she had left

21.name: Asha leaves the office
21.description: Asha gathers the records and walks out past the assistants without being noticed.
evidence: Asha gathered the trial record and the intake log into the crook of her arm and walked out past the assistants who did not look up

21.name: Cold reaches Asha outside
21.description: By the time Asha reaches the curb, the cold has soaked through her coat.
evidence: by the time she reached the curb the cold had gone all the way through her coat

21.name: Asha goes home instead of returning to work
21.description: Asha decides not to go back to the office and drives to her apartment.
evidence: She did not go to the office. She drove to the apartment

21.name: Asha confronts her unanswered messages
21.description: In her kitchen, Asha sees missed calls, a billing voicemail, and a social worker text about Marcus's discharge planning.
evidence: the silence of her own kitchen was the first silence she had stood inside in nine days that no one else was waiting at the other end of, and her phone, when she finally set it on the counter and looked at it, had three missed calls from Claire and a voicemail from Bridgepoint's billing office and a text from Marcus's hospital social worker that began with the words discharge planning meeting and asked her to confirm by noon who would be picking him up

21.name: Asha hesitates to call Claire
21.description: Asha opens Claire's contact and hesitates long enough for the screen to dim, imagining Claire's exhausted home life and deciding not to call.
evidence: Asha picked up the phone and pulled Claire's contact onto the screen, and her thumb hovered there long enough that the screen dimmed once and she had to wake it again. She watched Claire's name brighten and saw the kitchen on the other end of the line before she had pressed anything, two children at a table and a woman who had not slept, and she could not put Marcus through that door in a voice. She tapped back out without dialing

21.name: Asha opens social worker thread
21.description: After backing out of Claire's contact, Asha opens the hospital social worker's message thread to respond to the discharge request.

21.name: hesitates to call Marcus
21.description: She stops herself from dialing Marcus, unable to force him through the situation by voice.
evidence: she could not put Marcus through that door in a voice
She tapped back out without dialing

21.name: messages social worker about pickup
21.description: She opens the social worker's thread and sends a message saying she will not pick Marcus up and that the county step-down bed should be confirmed.
evidence: opened the social worker's thread, and typed that she would not be picking him up, that the county step-down bed should be confirmed

21.name: offers to release consent
21.description: She says she will call the unit herself to release any consent needed from her side.
evidence: that she would call the unit herself to release whatever consent they needed from her end

21.name: sets phone down after sending
21.description: After the message sends, she places the phone face down on the counter and rests her palm against it.
evidence: She set the phone face down on the counter after it sent and stood with her palm flat against the back of it

21.name: realizes brother is on same path
21.description: She understands that she has sent Marcus onto the same institutional track she recently pulled her father off of.
evidence: she understood, without rearranging the thought to make it easier, that she had just routed her brother onto the same track she had spent a week pulling her father off of

21.name: recognizes apartment unchanged
21.description: She registers that the apartment behind her is still the same room she entered an hour earlier and will not be different by noon.
evidence: the apartment behind her was still the room she had walked into an hour ago and would not be anything else by noon
